description:
Prove every patrol, never miss a round, schedule your team, and hand clients a signed shift report in minutes.

Phoenix Fire Watch is built for fire watch and security patrol companies that need reliable, verifiable records. Officers log rounds from their phones, admins manage the team and the weekly schedule, and everything syncs live with the web dashboard.

TIME-STAMPED PATROL LOGS
Record each patrol with date, time, officer, areas covered, and a Clear, Follow-up, or Incident status. Add notes and up to five live camera photos. Each photo is stamped with the time, property, and officer for credible proof of presence.

PATROL TIMERS THAT KEEP YOU ON SCHEDULE
Each property has its own repeating patrol timer. Officers get an alert five minutes before every patrol is due, delivered to the lock screen even when the app is closed. Admins set intervals from 15 minutes to 12 hours, and officers can turn timers on or off for themselves.

WEEKLY SHIFT SCHEDULE
Plan the week, Monday through Sunday, by property. Admins add staff names, assign day, night, or custom shifts, and repeat a shift across several days in one step. Overnight shifts are handled automatically. Officers see the schedule in the app, with their own shifts highlighted, so everyone knows where they need to be.

TRACK WHO'S BEEN PAID
Admins mark each shift paid with one tap, and paid shifts turn green. A weekly pay summary shows paid and scheduled hours for each person, and you can settle someone's whole week at once. Pay status is visible to admins only.

SIGNED PDF SHIFT REPORTS
Generate branded PDF reports grouped into 24-hour fire watch sessions, complete with officer e-signatures and photo pages. Share them by email or the share sheet to support compliance reviews, client requests, and inspections.

WORKS OFFLINE
Basements, stairwells, and job sites don't always have signal. Patrols, photos, and notes save on the phone and upload automatically when the connection returns. The schedule you last opened stays viewable offline.

TEAM MANAGEMENT FOR ADMINS
Your organization signs up, and admins add officers. Create officer logins, assign roles, reset passwords, and deactivate accounts when staff move on.

SHARED WATCH NOTES
Keep shift handoffs clean with watch notes that sync live across the team and the web dashboard, so the next officer knows exactly what's happening on site.

PRIVACY AND DATA CONTROL
Delete your account or organization directly in the app, and set optional data retention periods to match your company's policies.

No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. Just dependable tools for running professional fire watch and patrol shifts.

Download Phoenix Fire Watch and give your team and your clients proof of every round.
promotionalText: New: weekly shift scheduling. Assign staff to each site, mark shifts paid, and let officers see their week. Plus lock-screen patrol alerts and signed PDF reports.
whatsNew:
New: Weekly Schedule

- Plan the week (Monday to Sunday) by property, with day, night, and custom shifts. Overnight shifts are handled automatically.
- Admins add staff names, repeat a shift across several days at once, and edit or remove shifts with a tap.
- Mark shifts paid with one tap. Paid shifts turn green, and a weekly pay summary shows paid and scheduled hours per person. Only admins can see pay status.
- Officers see the team schedule, with their own shifts highlighted and a My Shifts filter.
- The schedule syncs live with the web dashboard, and the last week you opened is viewable offline.

Also in this update

- Team management for admins now lives in Account > Team & Logins.
